{
  "name": "gitleap",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "workspaces": {
    "packages": [
      "apps/*",
      "packages/*"
    ],
    "catalog": {
      "dotenv": "^17.4.2",
      "zod": "^4.4.3",
      "@types/bun": "^1.3.14",
      "hono": "^4.12.27",
      "@trpc/server": "^11.18.0",
      "better-auth": "^1.6.22",
      "stripe": "^22.4.0",
      "vitest": "4.1.8",
      "@vitest/ui": "4.1.8",
      "@vitest/coverage-v8": "4.1.8",
      "jsdom": "^29.1.1",
      "react": "^19.2.8",
      "react-dom": "^19.2.8",
      "@prisma/client": "^7.9.1",
      "@trpc/client": "^11.18.0",
      "@types/node": "^26.2.0",
      "@types/react": "^19.2.18",
      "@types/react-dom": "^19.2.4",
      "postcss": "^8.5.15",
      "tailwindcss": "^4.3.3"
    }
  },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "turbo dev",
    "build": "turbo build",
    "check-types": "turbo check-types",
    "dev:web": "turbo -F web dev",
    "dev:docs": "turbo -F docs dev",
    "build:docs": "turbo -F docs build",
    "check:docs": "turbo -F docs check-types",
    "dev:server": "turbo -F server dev",
    "db:push": "turbo -F @gitleap/db db:push",
    "db:studio": "turbo -F @gitleap/db db:studio",
    "db:generate": "turbo -F @gitleap/db db:generate",
    "db:migrate": "turbo -F @gitleap/db db:migrate",
    "test": "bun run --filter web test && bun run --filter server test && bun run --filter @gitleap/api test",
    "lint": "ultracite check",
    "format": "ultracite fix",
    "lint:doctor": "ultracite doctor",
    "knip": "knip",
    "knip:production": "knip --production",
    "secrets:scan": "gitleaks git --redact --verbose",
    "secrets:scan:staged": "gitleaks git --pre-commit --redact --staged --verbose"
  },
  "packageManager": "bun@1.3.5",
  "overrides": {
    "kysely": "0.28.17"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "dotenv": "catalog:",
    "zod": "catalog:",
    "@gitleap/env": "workspace:*"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "typescript": "^6.0.3",
    "@types/bun": "catalog:",
    "@gitleap/config": "workspace:*",
    "vercel": "^54.18.2",
    "turbo": "^2.10.0",
    "@biomejs/biome": "^2.5.7",
    "ultracite": "^7.10.1",
    "knip": "^6.32.0"
  }
}
